PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Financial Operations professional with 2+ years of experience in Asset Servicing, specializing in cash and position 
reconciliation, dividend and interest income processing, income accrual reconciliation, break investigation, and 
financial reporting. Experienced in resolving reconciliation exceptions, collaborating with global stakeholders, and 
ensuring accurate and timely processing of income -related events while meeting SLA and operational deadlines. 
Strong knowledge of trade lifecycle, corporate actions, and securities operations with excellent analytical and 
problem-solving skills. 
 
SKILLS AND INTEREST 
• Domain Expertise: Asset Servicing, Corporate Action, Trade Life Cycle, Financial Analysis, 
Reconciliation, Derivatives, Income Processing 
• Tools & Software: MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook), Bloomberg, DTCC, Bancs. 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Financial Associate 2 07/2023 - 05/2025 
State Street, Mumbai 
Cash Reconciliation 
• Performed daily reconciliation of dividend and interest payments of corporate action events between 
custodian and client records, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies. 
• Investigated and resolved high value cash breaks by performing detailed root cause investigation and 
coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. 
• Performed reconciliation for Tax and FX settlement breaks by analyzing transaction data, validating payment 
details, and coordinating with internal teams to resolve exceptions. 
• Monitored aged reconciliation breaks and ensured timely resolution in accordance with client SLAs 
and operational procedures. 
• Supported processing and reconciliation of corporate action income events, including dividend and 
interest payments. Addressed client queries by providing investigation updates and resolution within 
agreed turnaround times. 
Consultant 
BCT Consulting (On Contract) 01/2026 – 07/2026 
J.P. Morgan Chase, Mumbai (Client) 
• Prepared and delivered daily and weekly reports covering cash and position reconciliation breaks across 
investment banking operations teams. Collected and validated data from multiple sources to ensure accurate 
and timely reporting. 
• Reviewed SWIFT corporate action messages (MT564, MT566, and MT568) to verify event details, identify 
outstanding reconciliation breaks, and support accurate reporting. 
• Compared SWIFT message details with reconciliation reports and internal systems to investigate discrepancies 
and determine the status of outstanding breaks. 
• Coordinated with internal operations teams to validate data and resolve reporting discrepancies before final 
report distribution. 
• Maintained reporting documentation and supported daily operational reporting by ensuring data accuracy and 
completeness. 
• Developed a good understanding of the trade lifecycle and corporate action process through daily reporting 
and reconciliation activities. 
KEY PROJECTS 
Client On boarding 
• Contributed to the successful onboarding of a sensitive client by supporting reconciliation activities and 
ensuring a smooth transition into daily operations. 
• Investigated outstanding DTM and Abandoned Property breaks by analyzing backend data and supporting the 
concerned team with accurate information for resolution.
